tasks.subject: Implement real Serial support using go.bug.st/serial for cross-platform serial communication
tasks.description:
Replace the current serial stub implementation in tabby-go with a cross-platform solution using go.bug.st/serial. This involves:
1. Adding go.bug.st/serial as a dependency
2. Implementing serial port listing, opening, closing, and data transfer
3. Ensuring data forwarding works correctly
4. Testing the serial functionality with actual serial devices
